Precondition: Registration is complete and the OTP email has arrived
Test Steps: 1. Open the email and read the code 2. Enter the code on the OTP screen 3. Submit
Test Data: 6-digit code received by the dedicated test account
Expected Result: The email is verified and the user reaches their account
Actual Result: Message displayed: OTP is correct, signing in. The login options appears

Test Steps: 1. Enter a code that does not match 2. Submit 3. Observe whether the account opens
Expected Result: Verification fails and the account does not open
Actual Result: Verification was rejected with a wrong OTP message and the account did not open

Test Scenario: Submit with the OTP field empty
Test Steps: 1. Leave the OTP field blank 2. Submit
Expected Result: A validation message asking for the OTP
Actual Result: Message displayed: please Enter the OTP

Test Scenario: Verify after the OTP has expired
Precondition: An OTP was generated more than the validity period ago
Test Steps: 1. Register and note the time 2. Wait past the stated expiry 3. Enter the correct code and submit
Actual Result: Message displayed: OTP is expired click to resent it
Remarks: Check the email text for the stated validity period and test just before and just after it

Test Scenario: Reuse an OTP that was already used
Precondition: The OTP was verified successfully once
Test Steps: 1. Verify once successfully 2. Log out 3. Try the same code again
1. Enter a wrong code 2. Repeat at least 20 times 3. Check whether attempts are ever blocked
Expected Result: Attempts are limited or the account is temporarily locked
Remarks: Wrong OTP attempts are not limited. Logged as D-08.

Precondition: The OTP screen is open and no email arrived
Test Steps: 1. Look for a resend option 2. If present, use it and check that a new code arrives
Expected Result: A resend option exists and delivers a fresh code
Actual Result: Result : New otp is sent to mail

Test Scenario: Refresh the page on the OTP screen
Test Steps: 1. Refresh the browser 2. Try to enter the code and submit
Expected Result: The user can still complete verification

Test Scenario: Login before the email is verified
Precondition: An account was registered but the OTP was never entered
Test Steps: 1. Register a new account 2. Leave the OTP screen without verifying 3. Try to log in with those credentials
Expected Result: Login is blocked until the email is verified
Actual Result: Message displayed: The account doesnot exists
Remarks: Login is blocked as expected, but the message is unclear and should be reviewed separately.

Expected Result: Verification cannot proceed until all 6 digits are entered
Actual Result: The field waits for all 6 digits before allowing verification

Expected Result: The field limits input to 6 digits or rejects a longer code
Actual Result: The field accepts a maximum of 6 digits; a seventh digit cannot be entered

Test Scenario: Enter letters in the OTP field
Test Steps: 1. Enter letters in the OTP field 2. Submit
Expected Result: Letters are blocked or submission is rejected with a numeric-code message
Actual Result: Letters are not accepted; the field accepts numbers only

Test Scenario: Verify a valid OTP beginning with zero
Precondition: A valid code beginning with zero has been issued
Test Steps: 1. Enter the complete code including the leading zero 2. Submit
Expected Result: The leading zero is preserved and verification succeeds
Actual Result: Result : Not accept other then numbers
Remarks: The recorded result does not test whether a leading zero is preserved. Retest with a valid OTP beginning with 0.

Test Scenario: Use the previous OTP after requesting resend
Precondition: A second OTP has been requested
Test Steps: 1. Request a new OTP 2. Enter the previous OTP 3. Submit
Expected Result: The previous OTP is invalidated and rejected

Test Steps: 1. Select Resend repeatedly 2. Observe whether requests are delayed or limited
Expected Result: OTP resend is rate-limited by a visible cooldown period
Actual Result: A new OTP can be requested after a 2-minute cooldown
